Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning physical therapy copayment and coinsurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to physical therapy copayment and coinsurance; andadding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All health plans offered or renewed on or after January 1, 2015,and that provide coverage for physical therapy services, may not chargea covered person a copayment or coinsurance, or any combination of acopayment and coinsurance, for services rendered by a physicaltherapist licensed under chapter 18.74 RCW that is greater than thecopayment or coinsurance charged to the covered person for an officevisit for the service of his or her licensed primary care provider.
